[color=#cccccc]this mod just adds a bunch of [/color][b][color=#c27ba0]animated[/color][/b][color=#cccccc] doors and windows as a decor[/color]
[color=#cccccc]and as a [/color][b]bonus[/b][color=#cccccc] i've added an archive with *.pdn files, so you could quickly adjust the colors of the items OR change the background behind the "glass" entirely (you need [/color][b][u][color=#c27ba0]paint.net[/color][/u][/b][color=#cccccc] for that)
